When the stalk switch wheel is operated with the key ON, the side lights do not work

STEP

OPERATIONS TO BE CARRIED OUT

TEST RESULTS

1

INDIVIDUAL BULB CHECK

ALL OK

PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED

ACTION

Check the condition of the bulbs and associated bulb holder;

Move on to Step

1. Front bulbs damaged

1. Change the bulbs

2. Rear bulbs damaged

2. Change the bulbs

3. Tail-light fault

3. Repair or change the tail-light

4. Front light cluster fault

4. Repair or replace front light cluster

2

SIDE LIGHT ELECTRICAL CIRCUIT CHECK

ALL OK

PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED

ACTION

Check the following, in order:

  • side light fuses;
  • connections between battery, engine bay control unit, ignition switch, stalk unit and underfacia junction unit;
  • connections between underfacia junction unit and bulbs;
  • bulb earth

Move on to Step

1. Component defective

1. Replace defective component (in the case of a fuse, find out what caused it to blow).

2. Connections interrupted

2. Repair the connections

See E2010 SIDE LIGHTS / NO. PLATE LIGHTS

3

STEERING COLUMN SWITCH UNIT CHECK

ALL OK

PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED

ACTION

Check that a battery voltage output is generated to supply the side lights when the stalk switch wheel is operated with the key on.

Move on to Step

Stalk unit not working properly

Replace the steering column switch unit

See E2010 SIDE LIGHTS / NO. PLATE LIGHTS

4

IGNITION SWITCH CHECK

ALL OK

PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED

ACTION

Check that a battery voltage is generated when the ignition key is turned on and more specifically to the stalk switch that supplies the side lights

See E2010 SIDE LIGHTS / NO. PLATE LIGHTS

Move on to Step

Ignition switch fault

Repair or replace the ignition switch

Op. 5520A12 IGNITION SWITCH ASSEMBLY - R R FOR VERSIONS WITH AIR BAG

5

UNDERFACIA JUNCTION UNIT CHECK

ALL OK

PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED

ACTION

Check that a battery voltage output is generated from the underfacia junction unit to activate the bulbs when the stalk switch wheel is operated with the key on

See E2010 SIDE LIGHTS / NO. PLATE LIGHTS

Move on to Step

Underfacia junction unit fault

Repair or change the underfacia junction unit
